finding: PRE-REGISTERED POLICY for infrastructure aborts (exit=-11 SIGSEGV, exit=-9 OOM). An abort is NOT a task failure and NOT a pass — it is an infrastructure event. finding: Unit counterfactual over 96 failed-anchor calls (14 actionable + 5 friction). Precheck WOULD FIRE on 76 (79%) — but DOMINANT class is not_found=71, which is STATE-DRIFT CONFOUNDED (current on-disk state, not the pinned state the agent saw; some old_strings existed when patched but file changed since). CLEAN signal = ambiguous=5 (anchor present + non-unique in current state). Licenses: mechanism fires correctly on real anchors (both sub-types present), ambiguous class small (5, consistent with sub-mech split). Does NOT license 'caught 79% of failures' — the not_found majority is confounded. Throughput side (would precheck fire on friction/successful patches) needs PINNED-state version to answer; current-state is mechanism-sanity only, not magnitude.
why_not_fixed: n/a — measurement with honest confound disclosure. Next: pinned-state counterfactual for the throughput question; contrastive replays for the behavioral-existence side.

finding: THE MEASUREMENT (state-drift-confounded, stated): would-fire on actionable failures = 56/57 (98%), false-fire on successful patches = 790/1002 (79%), friction false-fire = 12/12, no-file = 36 (4 actionable). CONFOUND: current-state not pinned-state inflates BOTH rates same direction. DIRECTIONAL CONCLUSION that survives: precheck fires at high rate on BOTH failures and successes (~98% vs ~79%), so it CANNOT discriminate — an affordance interrupting 4/5 successful patches to catch the class is a bad trade. The specced read-then-anchor + uniqueness-precheck flow as designed is likely net-NEGATIVE. Honest options: (1) pinned-state to deconfound, but gap too small to rescue; (2) narrow precheck to ambiguous-only sub-class (catchable, costly, rare); (3) abandon as specced — finding = 'patch-anchor class is real but not affordably catchable via fire-loudly precheck'. This is the fairness-gate measurement; it cuts against the spec.
why_not_fixed: n/a — measurement. The branch found its real constraint: the affordance's throughput cost likely exceeds its catch value. Next = pinned-state deconfound or narrow-to-ambiguous or abandon.

finding: RETRACTION + CORRECTION. Last turn concluded the precheck is net-negative (79% false-fire). That conclusion was WRONG — driven by an unexamined 'ratio is robust' assumption. The 79% false-fire is STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE as a real rate: the patch tool errors on non-unique anchors (only 10/1028 successes used replace_all), so a successful NON-replace_all patch REQUIRED a unique anchor (count==1) at patch time. At patch-time the precheck would have returned would_fire=False. Therefore EVERY fire on a successful patch is file-state DRIFT since the patch — the TRUE false-fire rate on working paths is 0% by construction (783/995 measured fires are all drift). COROLLARY on catch rate: drift can only REDUCE a would-fire on a genuinely-failed anchor (a not-found anchor might now match once), so the 98% actionable catch rate is a LOWER BOUND; true catch is >=98%. VERDICT REVERSED: the affordance is NOT net-negative — it catches >=98% of the failure class and false-fires ~0% on working paths. Options 2 and 3 were premature; the spec as designed is viable. The instrument was misaligned (current-state vs pinned-state), and the user's interrogation caught it where my 'ratio is robust' reasoning papered over the asymmetric-drift objection.
why_not_fixed: n/a — measurement correction. The affordance is viable after deconfounding; proceed with the specced read-then-anchor flow. Lesson: never claim a false-fire rate from current-state when the tool's own success implies patch-time uniqueness.

finding: Guard: verified the uniqueness invariant from SOURCE, not error messages. fuzzy_match.py:173-179 — 'if len(matches)>1 and not replace_all' errors for EVERY strategy in the 9-chain; _SIMILARITY_STRATEGIES (block_anchor, context_aware) REFUSE replace_all on approximate matches. No first-match-wins, no fuzzy ambiguity fallback. replace_all=True is the ONLY exception (excluded, 10 cases). Ran the ACTUAL tool at current state on 995 successful non-replace_all patches: 357 still match (would NOT fire), 638 fail now (ALL drift — file changed since), 23 no_file. CONFIRMS the structural argument from code: true false-fire on working paths ~0% by construction + source-verified. THREE-ROW TABLE: catches failure class >=98% (lower bound), doesn't interrupt working patches ~0% (source-verified), fires on self-correcting cases 12/12 (real, separate, small win not absorbed). Named family now 3 instances: wrong entity / wrong state / wrong population — 'an instrument answering a different question than it appears to'.
why_not_fixed: n/a — verification. Invariant confirmed from source. Affordance viable; proceed with implementation + lab test.

finding: Ran the ACTUAL tool (fuzzy_match) against the actionable failures. Sub-mechanism split: ambiguous=11, not_found=41 (79%).
